scenarios.scenario_abstract: With a total budget of one hundred dollars for new computer glasses, [X] compares frame constructions against prescription-lens thickness, lens-edge visibility, facial presence, weight, repairability, and the amount left for the lenses.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在一百美元总预算内购买新的电脑眼镜时，[X]会根据处方镜片厚度、镜片边缘可见程度、对面部的强调、重量、可维修性以及能为镜片保留多少预算来比较镜框围边结构。
examples: using Full-Rim when continuous lens support and concealed edge thickness matter most
considering Semi-Rimless when reduced visual weight is worth exposed-edge care
considering Rimless only after prescription, drilling, repair, and total-price limits are checked

scenarios.scenario_abstract: At a midday Cartier appointment, [X] tries candidate frames with a quiet winter outfit and compares how much each construction outlines the eyes, reveals the lens edge, changes apparent weight, and holds its polished effect from showroom light into daylight.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 中午去试戴 Cartier 候选镜框时，[X]会穿着低调的冬季服装，比较不同围边结构对眼部轮廓的强调、镜片边缘的暴露、视觉重量以及从店内灯光到自然光下能否维持利落效果。
examples: using Full-Rim when a deliberate outline should anchor the face
choosing Semi-Rimless when the brow line can stay defined while the lower edge looks lighter
choosing Rimless when minimal facial interruption remains even and secure from the front and profile

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Across lessons, reading, phone study, and computer work, [X] repeatedly wears and cleans the same prescription glasses for nearsightedness, using the familiar pair to notice lens-edge grime, looseness, chips, visual obstruction, and whether a future construction should offer more support or less visible hardware.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在课堂、阅读、手机学习和电脑使用中，[X]会反复佩戴并清洁同一副近视处方眼镜，并借这副熟悉的眼镜观察镜片边缘污垢、松动、缺口、视野遮挡，以及未来镜框应提供更完整支撑还是更少可见五金。
examples: using the owned pair's cleaning and wear as evidence without inventing its current rim type
considering Full-Rim for stronger edge enclosure or Semi-Rimless for a lighter lower field
considering Rimless only after the student's prescription, handling, and repair access are checked

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For an open-air R&B stadium concert, [X] considers sunglasses to wear during sunny arrival, dancing, photographs, crowded security, concrete ramps, and storage after dark, making lens support, peripheral obstruction, weight, and snag risk consequential.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 参加露天 R&B 体育场演唱会时，[X]会考虑一副在阳光下入场、跳舞、拍照、拥挤安检、走混凝土坡道以及天黑后收纳的太阳镜，因此镜片支撑、周边视野遮挡、重量和勾挂风险都会产生实际影响。
examples: using Full-Rim when lens security during crowd movement matters more than minimal appearance
considering Semi-Rimless for lower visual weight while checking exposed edges and storage
considering Rimless only if the hardware and lenses tolerate repeated handling in a small bag

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While spraying aging peach and apple trees at home, [X] needs protective eyewear through overhead mist, branch contact, calm-weather application, rinsing, and seasonal reuse, and judges the edge construction by coverage, lens retention, cleanability, and compatibility with the actual safety rating.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在家中给老桃树和苹果树喷洒药剂时，[X]需要防护眼镜经历头顶雾滴、枝条碰触、静风施药、冲洗和季节性复用，并按覆盖范围、镜片固定、清洁便利以及是否符合实际安全等级来判断围边结构。
examples: favoring Full-Rim when continuous enclosure is part of a properly rated protective design
rejecting Semi-Rimless or Rimless when open edges undermine the required splash or debris coverage
never treating rim type alone as proof of chemical or impact protection

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For coastal walks, historical stops, driving, and resort time, [X] considers one pair of sunglasses and compares edge structures by facial coverage, salt and sand cleaning, lens security in luggage, weight, and ease of moving between water-adjacent and town settings.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为海岸步行、历史景点、自驾和度假村活动准备眼镜时，[X]会考虑只带一副太阳镜，并按面部覆盖、盐分与沙粒清洁、行李中的镜片稳固、重量以及在近水环境和城镇之间切换的便利来比较围边结构。
examples: using Full-Rim when travel handling and enclosed lens edges dominate
considering Semi-Rimless when lower visual obstruction is worth extra edge care
considering Rimless for low visual weight only after salt, sand, prescription, and repair constraints are known

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For an outdoor luncheon with twenty-five golf friends, [X] considers sunglasses as part of the chosen dress theme and compares how strongly the frame outlines the eyes, how light it looks in bright group photographs, and whether exposed lens edges suit an event with games and shared props.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 与 25 位高尔夫朋友参加户外午宴时，[X]会把太阳镜作为选定着装主题的一部分，并比较镜框对眼部轮廓的强调程度、在明亮合影中的轻盈感，以及暴露的镜片边缘是否适合包含游戏和共享道具的活动。
examples: using Full-Rim when eyewear should read as a deliberate theme cue in group photos
choosing Semi-Rimless for a defined upper line with less lower-face emphasis
choosing Rimless when a minimal look remains practical for the event rather than disappearing unevenly in photographs

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While installing a purchased bracket shelf on a concrete wall, [X] wears safety glasses through close-range leveling, pencil marking, masonry drilling, anchor setting, and tightening, judging the edge construction by particle coverage, lens retention, peripheral access to tools, and easy cleanup.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在混凝土墙上安装已经购买的支架置物架时，[X]会在近距离找平、铅笔标记、砖石钻孔、设置膨胀件和拧紧过程中佩戴安全眼镜，并根据颗粒覆盖、镜片固定、对工具的周边视野以及清理便利来判断围边结构。
examples: favoring Full-Rim when a properly rated continuous enclosure supports the drilling task
rejecting Semi-Rimless or Rimless when open edges conflict with the required particle coverage or lens retention
never treating rim type alone as proof that safety glasses meet an impact standard

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a summer trip to Italy, [X] considers one pair of sunglasses for hot streets, coastal stops, churches, restaurants, and repeated outfits, balancing facial presence, low weight, exposed-edge care, and travel repairability.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为意大利夏季旅行准备舒适又利落的精简行李时，[X]会考虑一副用于炎热街道、海岸停留、教堂周边、餐厅和重复穿搭的太阳镜，并权衡面部存在感、低重量、暴露边缘护理和旅行中的可维修性。
examples: using Full-Rim when one durable visual anchor must repeat across the capsule
choosing Semi-Rimless when a lighter lower edge works across day-to-evening outfits
choosing Rimless when minimal interruption justifies more careful packing and service planning

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a planned Alexandria shore-fishing trip, [X] includes polarized sunglasses in a tackle and first-aid plan and compares edge constructions by peripheral visibility, lens security on rocky ground, salt-spray cleaning, snagging near line and gear, and repair options away from home.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 计划去亚历山大岸边钓鱼时，[X]会把偏光太阳镜纳入渔具和急救方案，并根据周边视野、岩石环境中的镜片稳固、盐雾清洁、靠近鱼线和装备时的勾挂风险以及离家后的维修方式来比较围边结构。
examples: using Full-Rim when lens-edge support and field handling dominate
considering Semi-Rimless when a more open lower field helps while exposed edges remain manageable
considering Rimless only after retention, prescription, hardware, and repair tradeoffs are checked
